photos.desc: A couple of Blakiston's fish owls in Rausu, Shiretoko, Hokkaido, Japan. The male was catching a fish. This male won a battle against an old male, which had lived there, earlier in this year. He and a
After consuming two fish from a stream, a Blakiston's fish owl (Bubo blakistoni) flies off with a third fish to give to its mate waiting in a tree nearby. Rausu, Hokkaido, Japan.
A blakiston's fish owl hunting for fish
Blakiston's Fish Owl at Kushiro Zoological park, Japan.
